purpose: Measure the actual 4500-step DecisionVLA policy on RTX5090 GPU0 without CPU weight offload, with a paired BF16 reference.
training: Unchanged, continues on separate host GPU0/1
observations: 10 evenly spaced held-out LIBERO demonstration observations selected before model output

bf16.placement: CPU master streaming with CUDA arithmetic
bf16.reuse: Completed v1 ten measurements on identical hardware/model/source/inputs. V1 stopped on an overly broad hooks check, before any scored resident timing.

resident_w4.weights: Only frozen expert weights use symmetric group64 RTN INT4; remaining original types including FP32 LoRA
resident_w4.compute: GPU BF16 dequantization then original cached cuBLAS grouped GEMM

timing_boundary: PIL observation/instruction to 8x7 actions and full confidence diagnostics; excludes model load, image disk decode, warmup, RPC and robot execution
revision: v2 preserves original built-in hooks and asserts their identities unchanged; all weights/buffers CUDA; no streaming hooks installed in resident-only process.
